one_liner: aiXopt automates industrial machine settings with small-data AI; its 2026 RWTH Aachen Spin-off Award gives HTGF a reason to reach out now.

top_signals.signal: Won RWTH Aachen University's 2026 Spin-off Award.
Received the EXIST Gründerstipendium, a German government startup grant.

Ranked 4 of 63 leads today, with a model score 74.2 of 100 (above 98.8% of the reference cohort). The spin-off, deep-tech, founder doctorate and university background flags lifted the score; Germany lowered it. The technical-founder flag also lifted the score but is not confirmed by the founder records.

team: Dr.-Ing. David Stenger handles technology; Dr.-Ing. Tim Reuscher handles organization and external representation. The founder records list doctorates and RWTH Aachen University affiliations for both.
why_early: Unknown whether a priced round has occurred. The EXIST grant does not establish equity funding history.
devils_advocate_risks: Integration with existing manufacturing systems may be complex.
It is unknown how much work is needed to adapt the software across production environments.
next_step: HTGF Industrial Tech team: What measured improvement has aiXopt achieved against manual parameter tuning on a production machine?
